surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S1: The contract's Cottonwood bullets name the _s2 twins as read sources, but each _s2 table holds the 5-row xlsx report header (c1 label, c2 value), not account rows.

NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S2: The model join finds no roster row for one strategy name that carries 514 of the 998 live assignment rows; the adapter answers those accounts with absent_reason model_not_in_roster.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S3: fact_model_assignment does not join to the z09 account id; the adapter joins it on the custodian Account Number, and masked numbers do not join.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S4: The adapter raises or returns refusal codes that the contract does not name, and the protocol carries no channel for an absent_reason on an answered body.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S5: For Cottonwood transactions the contract gives no behaviour for a requested window that starts before the newest partition's earliest trade date.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S6: The census tool spec and the contract disagree on the Cottonwood fee rows: the census adds an Account Fee column, the contract names Management Fee rows only.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S7: fact_holdings carries no Custodian column, so the holdings platform label is derived from fact_allocations for the same account.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S8: Holdings carry duplicate (AccountID, AssetID) rows; the adapter sums them per asset as the census instructs, and the cause is not traced.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S9: The status flip of this task order to complete is outside this cell's write grant: the task order file is not in <paths>.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S10: The live newest partitions are newer than the census figures the contract cites.
NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-W106-S11: The commit-time naming gate refuses four firm-name literals in the Cottonwood adapter as hand-kept carriers; the gate is in its warn window, so the commit is not blocked.
